negative_cases: Oversize record rejected before shard publication
Explicit shard count exhausted: no unbounded extension
Resumed immutable shard reads rejected when source-read budget insufficient; existing bytes/inodes preserved
Retained partial exceeds resumed metadata cap: rejected, partial preserved
Packed census cannot be enabled for future/current index or per-file history
Disk increase becomes sticky failure at next prepublication census
limits_of_conclusion: No real raw logs/images/teacher payloads or full population were read or built
No active metadata contents scanned and no actual ledger/claim/admission/dispatch mutated
Existing writer and future metadata runtime remain untouched
Record buffers are <=4MiB, but all manifest/index rows and original source-log structures remain in RAM; full population peak is unmeasured
Total census cost is not proven linear: scans remain proportional to shard publications and retained shard count plus periodic scans
Resume reconstructs and rehashes source data; not cheap per-log skip resume
Cooperative checks need the already-required external finite monitor; sampled RSS is not a cgroup hard ceiling
The 5-second cached disk view is scoped to immutable packed storage; every actual publication/path check performs original census
No claim that4096 shards or existing disk allowance covers every real population; actual pilot and subsequent bounded admission are separate
